servinfo.title: Cooling System Draining
servinfo.ptxt: Before performing the following procedure, observe Precautions for Cooling System:K14D .

s1.ptxt: Remove degassing tank cap by turning it counterclockwise slowly to release pressure.
Hoist vehicle and remove engine undercover.
Loosen drain plug (1) on radiator to drain out coolant.

attention4.ptxt: If drain plug is tightened excessively, the plug could be damaged.
Do not tighten the drain plug too much.
